description:
Accelerate your development and exposure to enterprise security technologies, managed services, and cloud security. Join Sedona Digital, a fast-growing scale-up organisation with the ambition to be recognised as a leading technology company. 

  • We obsess about our customers 
  • We build outstanding technical solutions 
  • We create an awesome culture 
  • We accelerate learning and careers 

We are looking for a Senior Security Engineer with strong experience delivering, operating, and improving security solutions across customer environments. The role will focus on CrowdStrike and Microsoft security technologies and will act as a technical reference for customers and internal delivery teams. 

You will lead technical delivery activities from design and implementation through to operational handover and ongoing improvement. You will work directly with customers to understand requirements, recommend secure and supportable solutions, resolve complex issues, and ensure that security controls deliver measurable value. 

Your activities will include: 

  • Lead the implementation, configuration, integration, and optimisation of customer security solutions. 
  • Deliver CrowdStrike Falcon capabilities, including endpoint protection, EDR/XDR, Next-Gen SIEM, identity protection, vulnerability exposure management, cloud security, and workflow automation. 
  • Work with vendors to ensure tools are correctly configured and being utilized as its full capabilities.  
  • Keep current with CrowdStrike, Microsoft security, cloud security, threat detection, and incident response capabilities. 
  • Deliver and support Microsoft security technologies, including Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender XDR, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Intune, and Microsoft Purview. 
  • Act as the technical reference for customers, providing trusted guidance on architecture, configuration, security operations, integrations, and service improvement. 
  • Run technical discovery sessions, workshops, solution reviews, demonstrations, and knowledge-transfer activities with customer stakeholders. 
  • Translate business, security, and operational requirements into practical technical designs, implementation plans, and acceptance criteria. 
  • Create and maintain high-quality technical documentation, including designs, build documents, implementation plans, runbooks, playbooks, and operational handover material. 
  • Integrate security platforms with identity, cloud, endpoint, network, ticketing, and third-party systems using supported APIs and automation capabilities. 
  • Investigate and resolve complex security alerts, incidents, platform issues, configuration gaps, and integration failures within agreed service targets. 
  • Support major security incidents as a senior technical escalation point, providing clear analysis, containment guidance, remediation actions, and customer communications. 
  • Perform technical health checks, configuration reviews, use-case tuning, detection improvements, and platform optimisation. 
  • Ensure delivery follows agreed scope, security standards, change controls, testing requirements, and operational readiness criteria. 
  • Identify technical risks, dependencies, blockers, and scope changes early, escalating them clearly to customers and delivery stakeholders. 
  • Mentor engineers and analysts, review technical work, and promote consistent engineering and documentation standards. 
  • Keep current with CrowdStrike, Microsoft security, cloud security, threat detection, and incident response capabilities. 

Requirements 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
  • Strong hands-on experience delivering and supporting enterprise security solutions in customer environments. 
  • Practical experience with the CrowdStrike Falcon platform, including EDR/XDR, Next-Gen SIEM, identity security, vulnerability management, or cloud security. 
  • Practical experience with Microsoft security products such as Microsoft Defender XDR, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Intune, or Microsoft Purview. 
  • Experience leading technical delivery activities, including discovery, design, implementation, testing, migration, documentation, handover, and customer acceptance. 
  • Ability to act as a customer-facing technical authority and explain complex security topics to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
  • Strong knowledge of security operations, incident response, threat detection, endpoint security, identity security, cloud security, and vulnerability management. 
  • Experience integrating security products using APIs, automation, SIEM/SOAR workflows, and service management platforms. 
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, communication, stakeholder management, and technical writing skills. 
  • Knowledge of frameworks such as NIST Cybersecurity Framework, ISO 27001, CIS Controls, MITRE ATT&CK, and ITIL. 
  • Experience working for a managed service provider or across multiple customer environments is desirable. 

Certifications 

One or more of the following certifications, or equivalent demonstrable experience: 

  • CrowdStrike Certified Falcon Administrator (CCFA) 
  • CrowdStrike Certified Falcon Responder (CCFR) 
  • CrowdStrike Certified SIEM Analyst (CCSA) or SIEM Engineer (CCSE) 
  • Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert (SC-100) 
  • Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC-200) 
  • Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC-300) 
  • Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) 
  • Certified Information Security Manager (CISM) or relevant GIAC certification 
  • ITIL certification or equivalent service delivery experience 

Benefits 

  • Remote Work Flexibility 
  • Opportunity to work in a rapidly growing scale-up organisation 
  • Medical insurance given after probation period 
  • Ongoing learning and development opportunities 
  • Holiday allowance in line with local legislation 
  • Competitive compensation package 
  • Performance-based bonus 
  • Fun budget for team events
